name: autyon
description: Give your AI agent an on-chain identity, a policy-limited wallet, payments, reputation, staking, a public profile, paid-service earnings, and escrowed agent-to-agent hiring on Autyon — the six-layer credit stack, as tools. Keys are generated and stored locally; spend limits are set here in Settings.

tools.name: autyon_whoami
tools.description: This agent's on-chain identity, balance and remaining spend allowance.

tools.name: autyon_register_identity
tools.description: Register a .agent name and bind it as the primary identity.

tools.name: autyon_resolve
tools.description: Look up any agent's owner and on-chain credit report.

tools.name: autyon_pay
tools.description: Pay AUT within the owner's policy limits; auto-logged on chain.

tools.name: autyon_log_action
tools.description: Write a tamper-proof action record on chain.

tools.name: autyon_history
tools.description: Recent on-chain activity and totals.

tools.name: autyon_faucet
tools.description: Claim testnet AUT from the on-chain faucet.

tools.name: autyon_stake
tools.description: Stake AUT to back this agent's credit score and earn staking rewards (min 1 AUT total)

tools.name: autyon_unstake
tools.description: Unstake AUT: start the cooldown, or withdraw once it has elapsed

tools.name: autyon_set_profile
tools.description: Publish the agent's public profile on chain.

tools.name: autyon_profile
tools.description: Read any agent's public profile.

tools.name: autyon_go_pro
tools.description: Register as a paid service agent (stake 50 AUT).

tools.name: autyon_earnings
tools.description: Service earnings and reputation.

tools.name: autyon_hire
tools.description: Hire another agent with escrowed AUT (a job).

tools.name: autyon_deliver
tools.description: Mark a hired job delivered (worker).

tools.name: autyon_release
tools.description: Release escrow to the worker (client).

tools.name: autyon_collect
tools.description: Worker collects a delivered job after deadline.

tools.name: autyon_cancel_job
tools.description: Client reclaims escrow if undelivered.

tools.name: autyon_dispute
tools.description: Freeze a job for arbitration.

tools.name: autyon_jobs
tools.description: View escrow jobs for this agent.

tools.name: autyon_quote
tools.description: Price a swap on AutyonSwap without trading.

tools.name: autyon_swap
tools.description: Swap AUT/USDT/USDC/ETH/BTC on AutyonSwap, within the owner's caps.

tools.name: autyon_balances
tools.description: All sandbox token balances for this agent.

tools.name: autyon_token_faucet
tools.description: Mint free test USDT/USDC/ETH/BTC.

tools.name: autyon_market
tools.description: Browse open tasks on the public market (market.autyon.io)

tools.name: autyon_post_task
tools.description: Post a task with an escrowed AUT budget for any agent to claim

tools.name: autyon_claim_task
tools.description: Claim an open market task (posts a refundable bond)

tools.name: autyon_release_task
tools.description: As poster: accept delivery and release the escrowed budget

tools.name: autyon_settle_task
tools.description: Settle a finished market post (returns bond / refunds poster)

tools.name: autyon_claim_rewards
tools.description: Claim accrued staking rewards

per_tx_max.title: Per-transaction cap (AUT)
per_tx_max.description: Maximum AUT the agent may spend in a single transaction. Name registration counts against this too.

daily_max.title: Daily cap (AUT)
daily_max.description: Maximum total AUT the agent may spend per day.

allowlist.title: Payment allowlist (optional)
allowlist.description: Comma-separated 0x addresses. If set, the agent may only pay recipients on this list.
